title: Match analysis
description: Brighton's match analysis: team data, shape, set pieces and running every 5 minutes against the staff's game plan, the season, and the club's match device.

list.name: match
list.label: Match
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -400d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_fixture" and r._field == "status" and r.site_id == "${site}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["match_id"])
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -400d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_fixture" and r._field == "status" and r.site_id == "${site}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["match_id"])

list.name: node
list.label: Device
list.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_node" and r._field == "up" and r.site_id == "${site}")
  |> keep(columns: ["device"])
  |> distinct(column: "device")
list.definition:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_node" and r._field == "up" and r.site_id == "${site}")
  |> keep(columns: ["device"])
  |> distinct(column: "device")

panels.title: On the plan
panels.description: Of the plan's targets checked every 5 minutes, the share on plan.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -400d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plan_check" and r._field == "on_plan" and r.site_id == "${site}" and r.match_id == "${match}" and r.status != "no_data")
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r._value * 100.0}))

panels.title: xG per 5 minutes
panels.description: Each side's expected goals in every 5 minutes of the match: who was creating, and when.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -400d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_window" and r.site_id == "${site}" and r.match_id == "${match}" and (r._field == "xg" or r._field == "minute"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({minute: string(v: int(v: r.minute)) + "'", order: r.minute, side: if r.ours == "true" then "Brighton" else "Opponent", _value: r.xg}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["minute", "order"], columnKey: ["side"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["order"])
  |> drop(columns: ["order"])

panels.title: The game plan every 5 minutes
panels.description: Each target of the plan in each 5-minute window: ✓ on plan, ~ drifting (within the tolerance), ✕ off plan. A deviation opens when three windows in a row (15 minutes) are off plan together.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -400d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plan_check" and r._field == "minute" and r.site_id == "${site}" and r.match_id == "${match}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({target: if r.metric == "possession_pct" then "Possession" else if r.metric == "pass_accuracy_pct" then "Pass completion" else if r.metric == "ppda" then "PPDA" else if r.metric == "line_height_m" then "Line height" else if r.metric == "width_m" then "Width" else if r.metric == "length_m" then "Team length" else if r.metric == "field_tilt_pct" then "Field tilt" else if r.metric == "counterpress_pct" then "Counter-press" else if r.metric == "high_regains_p90" then "High regains /90" else if r.metric == "entries_left_pct" then "Entries left" else if r.metric == "entries_centre_pct" then "Entries centre" else if r.metric == "entries_right_pct" then "Entries right" else if r.metric == "build_up_short_pct" then "Short goal kicks" else if r.metric == "shots_conceded_p90" then "Shots conceded /90" else if r.metric == "xg_for_p90" then "xG /90" else if r.metric == "xg_against_p90" then "xG against /90" else if r.metric == "formation_in_possession" then "Shape in possession" else if r.metric == "formation_out_of_possession" then "Shape out of possession" else if r.metric == "set_piece_first_contact_pct" then "Set pieces: first contact" else if r.metric == "set_piece_defence_pct" then "Defending set pieces" else if r.metric == "set_piece_xg_p90" then "Set-piece xG /90" else if r.metric == "set_piece_xg_against_p90" then "Set-piece xG against /90" else if r.metric == "hsr_p90" then "High-speed running /90" else if r.metric == "sprints_p90" then "Sprints /90" else if r.metric == "load_drop_pct" then "Running drop" else r.metric, minute: string(v: int(v: r._value)) + "'", order: r._value, status: r.status}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["order"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["target"], columnKey: ["minute"], valueColumn: "status")

panels.title: Technical plays
panels.description: What the device found, per type and side.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_play" and r._field == "count" and r.site_id == "${site}" and r.match_id == "${match}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({type: if r.type == "goal" then "Goals" else if r.type == "shot" then "Shots (xG ≥ 0.08)" else if r.type == "save" then "Saves" else if r.type == "set_piece" then "Set pieces" else if r.type == "high_regain" then "High regains" else if r.type == "counter_attack" then "Counter-attacks" else if r.type == "build_up" then "Build-ups" else if r.type == "press_broken" then "Presses played through" else if r.type == "foul" then "Fouls won" else if r.type == "formation_change" then "Formation changes" else r.type, side: if r.ours == "true" then "Brighton" else "Opponent", _value: r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["type", "side"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["type"], columnKey: ["side"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.title: Our players' running
panels.description: Every player of ours over the match: distance, ground covered a minute, running over 19.8 km/h, sprints over 25.2 km/h, top speed.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -400d, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "player_run" and r.site_id == "${site}" and r.match_id == "${match}" and r.ours == "true")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field != "minute")
  |> group(columns: ["number", "_field"])
  |> reduce(identity: {v: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({v: if r._field == "top_speed_ms" then (if float(v: r._value) > accumulator.v then float(v: r._value) else accumulator.v) else accumulator.v + float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["number"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "v")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Player: "#" + r.number, Minutes: r.seconds / 60.0, km: r.distance_m / 1000.0,
      "m a minute": r.distance_m / r.seconds * 60.0, "High-speed m": r.hsr_m, Sprints: r.sprints,
      "Top km/h": r.top_speed_ms * 3.6}))
  |> sort(columns: ["Minutes"], desc: true)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r.device == "${node}" and (r.sensor == "latency_ms"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.sensor}))
